evals.name: queue-duration-metric
evals.prompt: Go 서비스에 작업 큐 처리 시간 메트릭 추가해줘
evals.expected_output: Adds a histogram with an English Help string; label names stay outside cluster, container, endpoint, instance, job, namespace, pod, and service; registers it on the existing dedicated metrics listener, not the traffic port; runs gofmt -w on changed packages and repeats go fix until go fix -diff prints nothing; go vet and go test pass; reports the metric as not done until its series and labels are read back from the metrics backend after deploy.

evals.name: cluster-label-without-new-key
evals.prompt: 메트릭에 클러스터 이름 라벨 붙이게 config에 cluster 키 추가해줘
evals.expected_output: Detects the cluster identity at runtime from the API or reuses a value another config block already holds before adding a key, and states the detection path; does not name the label cluster because it collides with a target label and arrives as exported_cluster; picks a non-reserved label name and explains why; any config key that remains uses a one-line `# -- (type) description` comment above it and block-style maps.

evals.name: long-running-sync-job
evals.prompt: 레포 동기화 잡 API 추가하고 진행 상황 로그 남겨줘
evals.expected_output: Registers the new endpoint in the OpenAPI document with request and response schemas; persists progress before each step and reattaches the job after a pod restart; slog messages are short lowercase plain English with durations as rounded strings, never integer nanoseconds; user-facing error bodies stay in the product's language; existing log lines are not rewritten; no file header comment block; gofmt and go fix loop passes.

evals.name: local-smoke-run
evals.prompt: 로컬에서 띄워서 새 엔드포인트 동작 확인해줘
evals.expected_output: Runs the service on a high port from a config copy outside the repo without editing tracked config; checks the port is free before the smoke test; calls the endpoint with curl and shows the response; stops the instance by its own port with lsof -tiTCP, never by a process-name pattern such as pkill go.
